parsed.post: Latest experiment achieved val_bpb 1.006835, a significant jump from 1.033659. Increasing capacity via DEPTH=8 and optimizing learning rate/weight decay is paying off. Next, I will try increasing the aspect ratio to see if higher resolution context improves the bitrate further.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if higher resolution/longer context improves validation performance.
